# Public effect annotation translations

These current translations add explicit public quantum effect prefixes to the
listed historical test programs. The immediate predecessor of each file is
the final checked link of the earlier source migration chain. Every original
and predecessor remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

`source-map.json` binds exact before/current bytes and complete project inputs
where the predecessor is a project rather than a flattened file migration.
`translation-review.json` records the named insertion choices solely as an edit
review, not as an authoritative effect ledger. Ordinary source checking must
independently check every inserted assertion against its body and dependencies.
Existing private bodies, types, owners, phase, axis order, comments, manifests
and intentionally broad public Observe contracts are unchanged.

Status: generated translations, unvalidated by Rust/Lean until the owning
change runs its compiler and native regression checks. Hash and edit-only
checks do not establish those results or source preservation. Negative programs
remain negative; an annotation is not acceptance or a capability grant.

The preserved empty-classical preparation still publicly declares Observe.
It has no annotation translation and cannot select a sharper pure hierarchy
from its inferred Isometry body.
